en.title: Brush Your Teeth Song with Momo the Bunny | Morning Routine for Toddlers
en.description:
Brush, brush, up and down! Join Momo the Bunny and Ducky for a happy morning tooth-brushing routine. A gentle say-along chant for toddlers and preschoolers (ages 2-5).

What we learn today:
1. A toothbrush and just a tiny dot of toothpaste
2. Brush up and down - top teeth and bottom teeth
3. Sip, swish and rinse with a cup of water

Say it with Momo and brush together every morning and every night!

#BrushYourTeeth #ToddlerLearning #KidsSongs #NurseryRhymes #MorningRoutine #PreschoolLearning #HealthyHabits #MomoTheBunny #BabySongs #LearnWithMomo

ko.title: 양치 동요 | 치카치카 이 닦기 | 아기토끼 모모
ko.description:
치카치카, 위로 아래로! 아기토끼 모모와 오리 더키가 아침 양치 습관을 알려줘요. 2~5세 아이를 위한 따라 말하기 챈트예요.

오늘 배우는 것:
1. 칫솔과 콩알만큼의 치약
2. 윗니는 위로, 아랫니는 아래로 치카치카
3. 물을 머금고 오물오물, 퉤! 헹구기

아침에도 밤에도 모모랑 같이 이를 닦아요!

#양치동요 #치카치카 #유아동요 #키즈송 #생활습관 #아침습관 #유아교육 #아기토끼모모 #양치습관 #모모랑배워요

narration.en: Hi friends! It's Momo!
narration.ko: 안녕, 친구들! 나는 모모야!

narration.en: Good morning, friends! The sun is up. Yawn! Time to start the day!
narration.ko: 좋은 아침이야! 해님이 떴어. 하아암! 오늘도 신나게 시작해 볼까?

cuts.image_prompt: [Momo] sitting up in a small cozy bed, stretching both arms up after waking, bright morning sunlight from a round window, soft pastel bedroom, clear empty pastel wall space in the upper third of the frame
cuts.motion: stretches both arms up slowly and yawns, ears bounce gently

narration.en: Hmm... my teeth feel fuzzy and sticky. What should we do, friends?
narration.ko: 음... 이가 까끌까끌 끈적끈적해. 친구들, 어떻게 하면 좋을까?

cuts.image_prompt: [Momo] standing in a bright pastel bathroom, one paw touching the cheek, curious puzzled face, small white teeth showing, clear empty pastel wall space in the upper third of the frame
cuts.motion: tilts head to one side and touches the cheek with one paw, ears bounce

narration.en: It's morning! Let's brush our teeth together! Brush, brush, brush!
narration.ko: 아침이야! 우리 같이 이를 닦자! 치카치카 치카!

cuts.image_prompt: a clean child-size bathroom sink with one round mint-green cup holding one small toothbrush, soft morning light, pastel tiles, clear empty pastel wall space in the upper third of the frame

narration.en: Look! This is a toothbrush. A little toothbrush. Toothbrush!
narration.ko: 이것 봐! 이건 칫솔이야. 작고 귀여운 칫솔! 칫솔!

cuts.image_prompt: close-up of one small child toothbrush with soft mint-green bristles and a yellow handle lying on a soft cream counter, plain pastel background

narration.en: Momo holds the toothbrush. My very own toothbrush! Hello, toothbrush!
narration.ko: 모모의 칫솔이야. 손에 꼭 잡아요. 안녕, 칫솔!

cuts.image_prompt: [Momo] standing at a small bathroom sink, holding up a small toothbrush with a yellow handle in one paw, proud happy face, clear empty pastel wall space in the upper third of the frame
cuts.motion: lifts the toothbrush up a little and smiles, ears bounce

narration.en: Now a little toothpaste. Not too much. Just a tiny dot!
narration.ko: 이제 치약을 짜요. 많이 말고, 콩알만큼만 쏙!

cuts.image_prompt: close-up of a small toothbrush with a tiny pea-size dot of white toothpaste on the bristles, next to a plain white toothpaste tube, soft pastel background

narration.en: Can you say toothpaste? [pause 1.5] Toothpaste! Yay, great job!
narration.ko: 치약, 따라 해볼까? [pause 1.5] 치약! 우와, 잘했어!

narration.en: Squeeze, squeeze, just a little bit of toothpaste. Perfect!
narration.ko: 쭉~ 치약을 아주 조금만. 딱 좋아!

cuts.image_prompt: [Momo] at the bathroom sink holding a small toothbrush in one paw and a plain white toothpaste tube in the other paw, focused cute face, clear empty pastel wall space in the upper third of the frame
cuts.motion: gently squeezes the tube over the toothbrush, small nod

narration.en: [chant] Brush up, brush down, brush your teeth all around! Brush up, brush down!
narration.ko: [chant] 위로 치카, 아래로 치카, 구석구석 치카치카! 위로 치카, 아래로 치카!

cuts.image_prompt: [Momo] facing the viewer holding a small toothbrush at the front teeth, big smile with a little white foam, bright pastel bathroom, clear empty pastel wall space in the upper third of the frame
cuts.motion: brushes the teeth with small up and down strokes, ears bounce

narration.en: Brush the top teeth. Up, up, up! Gently up, up, up!
narration.ko: 윗니를 닦아요. 위로, 위로, 위로! 살살 위로!

cuts.image_prompt: [Momo] seen from the waist up, brushing the top teeth with a small toothbrush, eyes looking up playfully, soft pastel-blue background with empty space above the head
cuts.motion: brushes with small upward strokes and blinks

narration.en: Brush the bottom teeth. Down, down, down! Gently down, down, down!
narration.ko: 아랫니를 닦아요. 아래로, 아래로, 아래로! 살살 아래로!

cuts.image_prompt: [Momo] seen from the waist up, brushing the bottom teeth with a small toothbrush, eyes looking down playfully, soft pastel-blue background with empty space above the head
cuts.motion: brushes with small downward strokes, small nod

narration.en: Up and down, up and down. Can you do it too? [pause 1.5] Yes!
narration.ko: 위로 아래로, 위로 아래로. 너도 해볼래? [pause 1.5] 그렇지!

cuts.image_prompt: [Momo] seen from the waist up with a big foamy smile, holding a small toothbrush near the mouth, twinkling eyes, soft pastel-yellow background with empty space above the head

narration.en: You did it! Great brushing, friends!
narration.ko: 잘했어! 치카치카 최고야, 친구들!

narration.en: Quack, quack! Here comes Ducky with a little cup of water!
narration.ko: 꽥꽥! 더키가 작은 물컵을 가져왔어!

cuts.image_prompt: [Momo] standing at the bathroom sink on the right side, [Ducky] waddling in from the left carrying a small mint-green cup, happy surprised faces, clear empty pastel wall space in the upper third of the frame
cuts.motion: Ducky waddles forward a little, Momo's ears bounce happily

narration.en: Water in the cup helps us rinse. Rinse, rinse, rinse!
narration.ko: 컵에 담긴 물로 입을 헹궈요. 헹구기, 헹구기!

cuts.image_prompt: close-up of a small mint-green cup filled with clear water on a clean white sink edge, soft sparkles on the water, plain pastel background

narration.en: Sip a little water. Swish, swish, swish! Funny puffy cheeks!
narration.ko: 물을 조금 머금고, 오물오물 오물! 볼이 빵빵해!

cuts.image_prompt: [Momo] holding a small mint-green cup, cheeks puffed out full of water, funny happy eyes, bathroom sink, clear empty pastel wall space in the upper third of the frame
cuts.motion: cheeks wobble gently side to side, ears bounce

narration.en: And spit it out! Ptooey! All clean and fresh!
narration.ko: 그리고 퉤! 깨끗하게 헹궜어. 상쾌해!

cuts.image_prompt: [Momo] leaning over a small bathroom sink, gently spitting a little water into the sink, [Ducky] watching from the counter, cheerful mood, clear empty pastel wall space in the upper third of the frame
cuts.motion: leans forward a little over the sink and smiles, Ducky flaps its wings

narration.en: Ducky asks: can you say rinse? [pause 1.5] Rinse! Hooray!
narration.ko: 더키랑 같이 말해볼까? 헹구기! [pause 1.5] 헹구기! 야호!

cuts.image_prompt: [Momo] and [Ducky] side by side at the bathroom counter, both smiling at the viewer, clear empty pastel wall space in the upper third of the frame
cuts.motion: both nod gently, Ducky flaps its wings once

narration.en: Let's remember! Toothbrush, toothpaste, and a cup of water!
narration.ko: 다시 한번 볼까? 칫솔, 치약, 그리고 물컵!

cuts.image_prompt: a neat row of a small toothbrush with a yellow handle, a plain white toothpaste tube and a small mint-green cup on a clean bathroom counter, soft morning light, clear empty pastel wall space in the upper third of the frame

narration.en: [chant] Brush up, brush down, swish and spit, all around! Swish and spit!
narration.ko: [chant] 위로 치카, 아래로 치카, 오물오물 퉤! 오물오물 퉤!

cuts.image_prompt: [Momo] happily dancing in the bathroom, holding a small toothbrush up high in one paw, clear empty pastel wall space in the upper third of the frame
cuts.motion: small hop in place holding the toothbrush up, ears bounce

narration.en: Show me your smile! Big, sparkly smile! Sparkly clean teeth!
narration.ko: 웃어 봐! 반짝반짝, 이가 반짝반짝!

cuts.image_prompt: [Momo] facing the viewer with the biggest smile showing clean shiny white teeth, one tiny sparkle near the teeth, soft pastel background with empty space above the head
cuts.motion: smiles wider and blinks, ears bounce

narration.en: Brush every morning and every night. Keep a big, bright smile!
narration.ko: 아침에도 밤에도 치카치카! 반짝반짝 웃어요!

cuts.image_prompt: [Momo] close-up holding a small toothbrush with a yellow handle next to the cheek, huge happy smile with shiny teeth, [Ducky] peeking in from the side, bright pastel-blue background with empty space above the head

narration.en: Bye-bye, friends! See you next time!
narration.ko: 친구들, 안녕! 다음에 또 만나!
